plugin.name: Password Vault
plugin.description: A personal encrypted vault for passwords and SSH keys, with folders and secure LAN sharing.

title: Password Vault
subtitle: Your personal vault on this device, available across workspaces.
desktopOnly: The password vault is available in the desktop application.
createHelp: Use at least 12 characters. Your master password cannot be recovered. Keep an encrypted backup in a safe place.
unlockHelp: Enter your vault's master password to access passwords and SSH keys.
search: Search names, usernames, sites and notes
selectRecord: Select a record to view its details.
name: Name
copied: Copied. Clipboard will be cleared after 30 seconds if unchanged.
deleteConfirm: Move this record to Trash? It will be kept for 30 days.
purgeConfirm: Permanently delete this record? This cannot be undone.
deleteFolderHelp: This removes the folder and all subfolders. Records will be moved to Unfiled.
deleteFolderRecords: Also move the records to Trash
sshHelp: Supports OpenSSH Ed25519 and RSA keys. A passphrase is required to validate an encrypted private key.
avoidAmbiguous: Avoid ambiguous characters (0 O o 1 I l)
selectRecordHint: Select a record from the list to view its details, or click New Record above.
destroyHelp: Permanently remove this device's vault, including its sharing key. Back up your records first. Enter your current master password above to continue.
destroyConfirm: I understand that this deletes every record in this device's vault.

importWarnings.unsupportedFields: TOTP, custom fields or attachments excluded

draftNotice: Unsaved edits are discarded when the vault locks. No plaintext drafts are stored.
securityNote: The vault locks when the app locks, the workspace changes or the system resumes. Records are not included in ordinary workspace sync.
plainWarning: This format contains plaintext credentials. Verify your master password and keep the exported file private. SSH keys require an encrypted backup or a separate key export.
exportDone: Export complete. Records: {{count}}; SSH records excluded by this format: {{excluded}}.
warnings: {{count}} items or fields were unsupported or invalid. Review before importing.
columnHelp: Enter the column heading for each field. Leave optional fields blank if absent.
importChanged: The file changed. Preview it again before importing.
shareHelp: Share a snapshot with one member of the current workspace. Saved copies cannot be recalled.
verifyFingerprint: I verified this fingerprint with the recipient
keyChanged: The recipient key has changed. Verify the new fingerprint before sending.
enableToReceive: Enable and unlock Password Vault to view this share.
unlockToReceive: Unlock Password Vault to view this share.
sentShare: A credential snapshot was shared with this person.
sharePublicOnly: Only the public key and fingerprint will be shared.

errors.VAULT_UNINITIALIZED: Create and unlock a vault first.

errors.VAULT_RETRY: Too many failed attempts. Wait briefly and try again.
errors.VAULT_NOT_FOUND: This record or folder no longer exists.
errors.VAULT_CONFLICT: This record changed. Reload it before saving.
errors.VAULT_FOLDER_CYCLE: A folder cannot be placed inside itself or one of its descendants.
errors.VAULT_FOLDER_EXISTS: A folder with this name already exists at this level.
errors.VAULT_SSH: Use a valid OpenSSH Ed25519 or RSA key.
errors.VAULT_SSH_PASSWORD: The private key passphrase is incorrect.
errors.VAULT_SSH_MISMATCH: The public and private keys do not match.
errors.VAULT_FILE: The file could not be read or written.
errors.VAULT_FILE_SIZE: The file exceeds the supported size.
errors.VAULT_FILE_EXISTS: Choose a new filename. Existing files are not overwritten.
errors.VAULT_CSV_MAPPING: Map the Name field to a CSV column.
errors.VAULT_IMPORT_CHANGED: The file changed. Preview it again.
errors.VAULT_WINDOW: Open the vault in the main application window.
errors.VAULT_RECIPIENT: This share does not belong to the current user or workspace.
errors.VAULT_VERIFY_FINGERPRINT: Verify the recipient's fingerprint before sharing.
errors.VAULT_SHARE_IDENTITY: The sender or recipient identity could not be verified.
errors.VAULT_SHARE_KEY: This share was encrypted for a different vault key.
errors.VAULT_SHARE_IMPORTED: This shared record has already been saved.
errors.VAULT_RECIPIENT_OFFLINE: The recipient is offline and no verified key is cached.
errors.VAULT_RECIPIENT_UNSUPPORTED: The recipient needs a compatible application with an initialized and enabled vault.
